theme: A clear travel day, and two holiday bookings that have waited long enough.
greeting: The calendar is open today, Dan, with a stop in Fredericksburg and the road south toward St. Pete. No meetings means this is the right morning to finally close the two holiday bookings that keep slipping.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority Todoist task: hold a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week. It is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out, and it has been open since mid-September.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by was Sept 30 and the book-by was Oct 15, both now passed. Six people, three weeks, over the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year, so a domestic shortlist needs picking before the choice makes itself.

flagged.title: NACD New England run of show
flagged.detail: Laura Ravetto sent the run of show for next week's Oct 28 NACD New England event. Worth a skim so you arrive knowing your part.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shop promos: Italian word-of-the-day, book shops, coffee gear, and a stack of hotel and travel deals.

acts.line: A clear morning in Fredericksburg, with nothing on the calendar to work around.
The day is unclaimed; the two holiday bookings are the one thing worth spending it on.
